scripts.dev: concurrently -n admin,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.maps:up: npm run maps:prepare && docker compose --file maps/compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.maps:update: bash maps/prepare.sh --refresh && docker compose --file maps/compose.yml up -d --wait --force-recreate tileserver
scripts.routing:up: npm run routing:prepare && docker compose --file routing/compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.routing:update: bash routing/prepare.sh --refresh && docker compose --file routing/compose.yml up -d --wait --force-recreate routing
scripts.build: npm run api:client && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/admin run build && npm --prefix apps/merchant run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/admin run lint && npm --prefix apps/merchant run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm test && npm --prefix apps/merchant test && npm run test:print-agent
scripts.api:client: npm --prefix apps/api run openapi && openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o packages/api-contract/src/schema.ts
